Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001176": On 2026-04-14, team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: team Dune, reporting service, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1001146": As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service.  (about: Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000279" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000128": The reporting service is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000856": As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: team Dune, Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1000852": As of 2025-12-05, the pager for reporting rings the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, reporting)
- memory_id "1001227": On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: ledger service, Ember team, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1001232": As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team's on-call rotation.  (about: Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001235" [decision]: As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, having taken over from Diego.  (about: Diego, Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1001222": On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, indexer, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1001017": As of 2026-03-02, Oskar Lind is on the Ember team's on-call rotation.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000955" [decision]: As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000818": As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team.  (about: Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000771": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Ember team, the marketing send, billing service)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000829": As of 2025-11-27, the Ember team consists of Oskar and Diego.  (about: Diego, Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1001121": On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout and flagged it as not their service.  (about: Atlas team, the client rollout, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1001023" [constraint]: As of 2026-03-03, the auth gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000915" [decision]: As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
Existing entity names: team Dune, reporting service, Tuesday's deploy, Ember team, ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting, Diego, Oskar, Atlas team, indexer, the marketing send, billing service, job scheduler, the client rollout, webhooks, auth gateway
